hook.en: Your grandparents' first mobile could only make calls. Your phone streams HD video and controls smart devices. Each 'G' was a generation of technology.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅಜ್ಜ-ಅಜ್ಜಿಯರ ಮೊದಲ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಕರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ HD ವೀಡಿಯೊ ನೋಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ 'G' ಒಂದು ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ತಲೆಮಾರು.

objectives.en: Match each generation with its key feature

narration.en: Your grandparents' first mobile could only make calls. Your phone streams HD video and controls smart devices. Each 'G' was a generation of technology.
narration.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅಜ್ಜ-ಅಜ್ಜಿಯರ ಮೊದಲ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಕರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ HD ವೀಡಿಯೊ ನೋಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ 'G' ಒಂದು ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ತಲೆಮಾರು.

body.en: 1G (1980s): analog, voice calls only. 2G (early 1990s): digital; added SMS and MMS; technologies GSM and CDMA. 3G (2000s): faster data, mobile Internet, video calls. 4G (2010s, LTE): high-speed mobile broadband for HD video streaming and online gaming. 5G: very high speed, very low latency and support for huge numbers of connected devices, enabling IoT, smart cities and remote applications.

points.en: 5G: very high speed, low latency, IoT

narration.en: 1G was analog voice. 2G went digital with SMS. 3G brought mobile Internet. 4G gave high-speed broadband, and 5G adds very low latency for IoT.
narration.kn: 1G ಅನಲಾಗ್ ಧ್ವನಿ. 2G ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್, SMS. 3G ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ. 4G ಅತಿವೇಗದ ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್, 5G IoT ಗೆ ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ವಿಳಂಬ.

problem.en: Which generation is the minimum needed for each: (i) sending an SMS, (ii) a video call, (iii) streaming HD video smoothly, (iv) thousands of sensors in a smart factory needing instant response?

steps.en: (iii) Smooth HD streaming needs broadband speeds → 4G.
(iv) Massive IoT with very low latency → 5G.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Which generation is the minimum needed for each: (i) sending an SMS, (ii) a video call, (iii) streaming HD video smoothly, (iv) thousands of sensors in a smart factory needing instant response?

body.en: Count up: 1 = voice, 2 = text, 3 = Internet, 4 = video, 5 = everything connected.

narration.en: Count up: 1 = voice, 2 = text, 3 = Internet, 4 = video, 5 = everything connected.
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

points.en: 5G: very high speed, low latency, massive IoT.
points.kn: 5G: ಅತಿ ವೇಗ, ಕಡಿಮೆ ವಿಳಂಬ, ವ್ಯಾಪಕ IoT.

homework.en: Ask an elder which mobile generation they first used and what it could do.

narration.en: Recap. 1G analog voice; 2G digital with SMS. 3G mobile Internet; 4G high-speed broadband. 5G: very high speed, low latency, massive IoT.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. 1G ಅನಲಾಗ್ ಧ್ವನಿ; 2G ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಜೊತೆ SMS. 3G ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಅಂತರ್ಜಾಲ; 4G ಅತಿವೇಗ ಬ್ರಾಡ್‌ಬ್ಯಾಂಡ್. 5G: ಅತಿ ವೇಗ, ಕಡಿಮೆ ವಿಳಂಬ, ವ್ಯಾಪಕ IoT.
